case.narrative: Cabin heating stays cold for the first twenty minutes of every drive. The workshop found an open circuit in the high-voltage battery heater and no fault in the cabin blower.

extraction.summary: High-voltage battery heater open circuit leaves cabin heating cold at start-up.

conditions: first twenty minutes of every drive

clues.quote: open circuit in the high-voltage battery heater

proposal.summary: Run a 2-hour low-temperature heater circuit test
proposal.rationale: The open circuit appears only at cold start and the fault code points at the heater element, so a low-temperature load test separates the element from the connector.

targeted_test.name: Low-temperature heater circuit test
conditions: measure element resistance and connector voltage drop
targeted_test.reason: Cold-only open circuit with P0C73 matches a connector or element fault that a warm standard test will miss.
